shipped.name: SUNDAY — Job-Hunt Agent
shipped.tagline: An agent that hunts jobs while I sleep.
shipped.description: Every morning at 10:00 IST it scrapes AI/ML intern and fresher openings, ranks them against my real resume, builds ATS-safe resume and per-company cover-letter PDFs, and emails me the top five. I reply with a company name — it applies. It never emails the same company twice.
shipped.note: Runs live for me daily — the deployment stays private (it holds my resume data).

shipped.name: WhisperFlow Local
shipped.tagline: Fully offline dictation for Windows — hold a key, speak, done.
shipped.description: Hold a global hotkey and talk; your words appear at the cursor in whatever app is focused. Silero VAD gates the mic, faster-whisper transcribes on CPU (int8), and a local Ollama model polishes the text. No cloud anywhere in the pipeline — about 1.5 s end-to-end on an i5 laptop with no GPU.

shipped.name: NSE Swing-Trading Bot
shipped.tagline: Real money, hard caps, honest gates.
shipped.description: An automated swing trader for Indian equities, capped at ₹1,000 of real capital. It goes live only through backtest → paper → live gates. Dual-broker architecture: Upstox's free API feeds market data while Zerodha executes with ₹0 delivery brokerage. Reports every move to Telegram.

shipped.name: Stock News Monitor
shipped.tagline: A news-sentiment system that grades its own predictions.
shipped.description: Scrapes trusted Indian financial feeds, matches headlines to NSE tickers, and scores sentiment — then checks itself against what each stock actually did the next trading day. An autonomous ₹5,000 paper trader learns source trust and sector weights from its own wins and losses.

shipped.name: Sunday: Interview Strategy
shipped.tagline: The layer above LeetCode — which company asks what, in which round.
shipped.description: A placement-prep platform mapping companies → interview rounds → real questions, with topic mastery tracking, per-company readiness scores, and next-best-action suggestions. Built single-user and PIN-gated by design.
shipped.note: Private build — it holds my actual prep state.

shipped.name: Chief of Staff
shipped.tagline: A Telegram chief of staff with zero authority.
shipped.description: Morning briefing in, prioritized checklist out; an evening check-in closes the loop. It tracks an 8-8-8 time budget across personal, professional, and social hours — and nags exactly once. The bot structures; I decide.

shipped.name: MUN Prep Platform
shipped.tagline: Evidence-backed Model UN dossiers with live-verified citations.
shipped.description: Takes a committee, country, and agenda, and produces a complete delegate dossier — country profile, position paper, speeches, resolution clauses — where every claim traces to a fetched and verified source. Official documents labelled primary; reputable secondary sources labelled as such.

upcoming.name: CodeLens
upcoming.description: Write DSA code and watch it execute live — memory, stack frames, heap objects, pointer arrows, recursion trees — animating as you type. One language-agnostic trace engine drives every panel; Python, C++, and Java plug into it. Reverse execution comes free: the whole run is a scrubbable timeline.
upcoming.meta: Designed in full · build starts next

upcoming.name: ECG Interpreter
upcoming.tagline: Deep learning on 12-lead ECGs — explained honestly.
upcoming.description: A 1D-CNN/ResNet trained on PTB-XL to flag cardiac abnormality classes, paired with deterministic signal features (intervals, rhythm, axis) and a grounded explanation layer that can only say what the classifier and measurements support. Educational tool — never a medical device, and it says so on every screen.
